Configuration reference

rvis authors

Source: vignettes/configuration.Rmd
configuration.Rmd

Pass configuration as a named list in config:

rvisPlot(
  type = "bar", plotter = "amCharts", obj = summary_data,
  x = "category", y = "value",
  config = list(
    title = "Quarterly results",
    legend.enabled = TRUE,
    legend.position = "bottom",
    barMode = "stack"
  )
)

Configuration is interpreted by the selected wrapper. The same key may be unsupported or have a different default in another plotter. The table below lists every property currently recorded in data/properties.csv, including its wrapper, declared type, default, and allowed values. Use only keys listed for the selected wrapper. The property names are case-sensitive.

General interpretation

Axis keys control labels, ticks, grid lines, ranges, and scrollbars. Legend keys control visibility, placement, and appearance. title and subtitle set chart headings. Graph wrappers use node.* and link.* keys for network elements. Keys such as additionalColumns retain extra columns for custom tooltips or formatting. The exact wrapper behavior is implemented in that wrapper’s manual and source code; values and defaults in the table are the package’s current validation metadata.

When a key is not present in this table, check the wrapper’s function documentation and the ... arguments it forwards to its underlying plotting package.
